# Aurora Desktop Game Center

Aurora Game Center is the unified console/computer emulation panel for Chimera II OS.

The registry covers Atari, Nintendo, Sega, Sony PlayStation, NEC, SNK, 3DO, Bandai, MSX, Commodore, Sinclair, Acorn, arcade, DOS and classic adventure platforms, with libretro cores where appropriate and native emulator backends for higher-end systems.

RetroArch/libretro is used as the modular integration layer because libretro exposes standardized audio/video/input callbacks and supports dynamically loadable cores. The official core list includes systems such as Atari, NES, SNES, Game Boy, PlayStation, Saturn, Dreamcast, GameCube/Wii, DOS and others.

Aurora does not bundle commercial ROMs, proprietary BIOS, or firmware. The Game Center can scan and launch user-owned or legally redistributable content and can hand off to the existing PlayStation Center.

## Panel

The Aurora panel provides:

- All Systems
- Favorites
- Recently Played
- Installed Cores
- Console Families
- Arcade
- PC Classics
- Scan Library
- Detect Core
- Launch
- Import User-Owned Dump
- Verify Hash
- Core Manager

The registry is intentionally extensible so additional open-source emulator backends can be added without redesigning the Aurora UI.
